description:
Flaccy plays the music you own at full quality: FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3 and AAC. A native Mac app with a real equalizer, gapless playback, synced lyrics, Last.fm scrobbling and a menu bar player. No account, no ads, and your files never leave your Mac.

SEE EXACTLY WHAT YOU'RE HEARING
• Codec, bit depth and sample rate on every track, from CD quality to Hi-Res
• Gapless playback that honors your albums (exact for lossless files), with a queue that survives relaunches
• A built-in Listening Guide that explains what Bluetooth, wired DACs and your Mac really deliver. No snake oil

A REAL EQUALIZER
• Drag the curve and hear it change, or switch to Advanced for up to ten bands with bells, shelves, filters and adjustable Q
• 16 presets and your own. Import Equalizer APO and AutoEq profiles to tune for your headphones
• A separate setting for every output: AirPods, a wired DAC, the speaker. Flaccy switches when you do
• Automatic headroom keeps boosts from clipping, and Hold to compare is level-matched, so louder never sounds better
• Keyboard-first: arrows move a band, ⌥⌘E opens it from anywhere
• Works with every format and keeps playback gapless. Off or flat, the signal passes through untouched

YOUR LIBRARY, ORGANIZED
• Index your music folder in place: no copying, no locked-in library format
• Folder watching: files you add appear instantly, and messy folder names and scene releases are identified and cleaned up automatically (AI cleanup is included in the trial and in Lifetime)
• Albums, artists, songs and playlists with search, multi-column sorting and large artwork
• Duplicate songs are listed once, and Flaccy builds smart playlists from your own listening

MADE FOR THE MAC
• Liquid Glass design built natively for macOS
• Media keys, a menu bar mini player and Control Center Now Playing
• Keyboard-first: play, love, queue and search without touching the mouse
• Drag-and-drop import, right-click everything, and synced lyrics with click-to-seek
• AirPlay, a sleep timer and an immersive Now Playing view with lyrics and queue side by side
• Zoom the whole window with ⌘= and ⌘-

SCROBBLE EVERYTHING
• Sign in with Last.fm and every play is scrobbled, even offline, with automatic retry
• Listening charts, a listening clock and artist bios matched to your library
• Year in Music: shareable story cards and a poster of your listening year, exportable at full resolution

REDISCOVER YOUR COLLECTION
• Start a station from any song: Flaccy builds a queue from your own library
• Suggested playlists, similar-artist trails, and a wantlist for the albums you're hunting
• Share any track as a universal streaming link while you keep your FLACs

TRY IT FREE
Flaccy is free for 7 days from the first time you play your own music. After that, keep everything with a one-time Lifetime purchase, or choose the yearly plan. The yearly plan renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Flaccy plays FLAC, ALAC, AAC, M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF and CAF.

whatsNew:
The equalizer is here.

• Drag the curve and hear it change. Switch to Advanced for up to ten bands with bells, shelves, filters and adjustable Q
• 16 presets, your own saved profiles, and import of Equalizer APO and AutoEq text
• A separate setting for every output, so AirPods, a wired DAC and the speakers each sound right
• Automatic headroom, a level-matched Hold to compare, and a live spectrum
• Gapless playback stays intact, and when the equalizer is off nothing touches your audio

Open it from the transport bar, the Playback menu or ⌥⌘E.
